statement:
∀ (n₁ n₂ R₁ R₂ x y : ℝ),
  R₁ ≠ 0 →
    R₂ ≠ 0 →
      deriv (deriv fun x => cos (n₁ * x / R₁)) x + deriv (deriv fun y => cos (n₂ * y / R₂)) y =
        -(n₁ ^ 2 / R₁ ^ 2) * cos (n₁ * x / R₁) - n₂ ^ 2 / R₂ ^ 2 * cos (n₂ * y / R₂)

goal.text:

goal.rhs: -(n₁ ^ 2 / R₁ ^ 2) * cos (n₁ * x / R₁) - n₂ ^ 2 / R₂ ^ 2 * cos (n₂ * y / R₂)
goal.lhs: deriv (deriv fun x => cos (n₁ * x / R₁)) x + deriv (deriv fun y => cos (n₂ * y / R₂)) y

deriv fun y => cos (n₂ * y / R₂)
